key_terms.السَّبِيلَ: the path or way (specifically the path of birth)

ai.seo_question: What does 'Then made his passage easy' refer to in Surah Abasa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the divine ease in human creation as a precursor to the ease of spiritual return, contrasting with the difficulty of the path to knowledge. It reflects the concept of *Yusr* (ease) in the cosmic order, affirming that just as entry into the world is facilitated, so too is the journey toward divine proximity made accessible through God's grace.
